dialogues.jp: 出席簿をもって、暦先生が教室に入ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Holding the attendance records in her hand, Koyomi-sensei
entered the classroom.
dialogues.text:
Holding the attendance records in her hand, Koyomi-sensei
entered the classroom.

dialogues.jp: いつも通りの朝の風景――。
（いつも同じってのも飽きるよな……）
dialogues.en: "(And the usual tiresome look as well...)"
dialogues.text: "(And the usual tiresome look as well...)"

dialogues.jp:
たまには違った感じで来てくれると、こっちも
朝礼が楽しみになるんだけど。
dialogues.en:
If she just did things differently once in a while, she
could liven up this time of the day.
dialogues.text:
If she just did things differently once in a while, she
could liven up this time of the day.

dialogues.jp:
屋上からロープを伸ばして、窓ガラスを割って
登場するとか……。
dialogues.en:
Like rappeling from the school building and coming in
through the window...
dialogues.text:
Like rappeling from the school building and coming in
through the window...

dialogues.jp:
（……うむ。そんなんだったら皆の遅刻も減る
　だろうな）
dialogues.en:
"(...If that happened, I bet the tardiness rate will drop
dramatically.)"
dialogues.text:
"(...If that happened, I bet the tardiness rate will drop
dramatically.)"

dialogues.jp:
フリフリの衣装を着た暦先生ってのにも、興味
があるかも。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei wearing something fluffy would certainly cause
some commotion.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei wearing something fluffy would certainly cause
some commotion.

dialogues.jp:
（キャラの雰囲気とのアンバランスさが、かえっ
　てそそる……）
dialogues.en:
"(It'd be a complete distinction from her actual
character...)"
dialogues.text:
"(It'd be a complete distinction from her actual
character...)"

dialogues.jp:
絶対極秘の妄想を膨らませている間に、ＨＲが
終わる。
dialogues.en:
Vowing to myself never to reveal this to anyone, HR quickly
ended.
dialogues.text:
Vowing to myself never to reveal this to anyone, HR quickly
ended.

dialogues.jp:
いつも通りの暦先生のＨＲ。ちょっと違ったこ
とを想像してみる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's usual HR. It'd be more interesting if she
shook things up a little.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's usual HR. It'd be more interesting if she
shook things up a little.

dialogues.jp:
窓を突き破って突入、コスプレ、そしてフリフ
リ衣装の暦先生。
dialogues.en:
Like breaking the window to enter the class, cosplay, or
wearing a fluffy costume.
dialogues.text:
Like breaking the window to enter the class, cosplay, or
wearing a fluffy costume.
